cards.name: Roborock Saros 10R
cards.price: Real deal at $899 or less · great at $850 (list $1,600; most of 2026 near $900)
cards.buy_if: it's at or under $899 and you want 2026's best all-round robot — the October event has a real shot at $850.
cards.skip_if: the page shows $1,000-plus with a giant 'coupon' — that's the list-price game, not a deal — or you'd rather spend under $600 (see the Roomba below).
cards.owners: Owners praise how rarely it needs rescuing. The top complaint is the dock's auto-empty port clogging in multi-pet homes — check it monthly.

cards.name: Dreame X50 Ultra
cards.price: Real deal at $799 or less (list $1,700; 2026 range $800–$1,050)
cards.buy_if: you want the robot that climbs thresholds and crosses steps, and it drops to $800 or less — it touched $800 in the summer event.
cards.skip_if: it's still $900-plus; at that money the Saros 10R is the better buy.
cards.owners: Owners are amazed by the climbing. Complaints: it still gets stuck on some thresholds, and the dock is huge.

cards.name: iRobot Roomba Max 705 Vac
cards.price: Real deal at $499 or less (list $900; sale range $500–$650)
cards.buy_if: you want a self-emptying robot from a brand with US phone support for under $500.
cards.skip_if: you need mopping (this one only vacuums) or it's above $550.
cards.owners: Owners praise the tangle-free rubber rollers. Worries centre on iRobot's future after its bankruptcy.

cards.name: Apple AirPods Pro 3
cards.price: Real deal at $199 · buy instantly at $179 or less (list $249; summer low $169)
cards.chip: Best on iPhone · heart rate · hearing aid
cards.buy_if: you're on iPhone — $199 is already close to the floor, and October may bring $169–$179 again.
cards.skip_if: you see 'AirPods Pro' at $150: check it's the Pro 3, not the older Pro 2 on clearance.
cards.owners: Owners love the fit and the noise cancelling. Complaints: the case scratches, and batteries can't be replaced.

cards.name: Sony WF-1000XM6
cards.price: Real deal at $278 or less (list $330; sale range $279–$299)
cards.buy_if: you want the best noise cancelling on any phone and it drops under $280 — its first real cut is due.
cards.skip_if: you can wait: Black Friday is where the XM6 should hit its lowest of the year.
cards.owners: Owners praise the sound and the battery. The complaint is fit for small ears, and the price.

cards.name: Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen 2
cards.price: Real deal at $499 or less · great at $449 (list $799)
cards.buy_if: you want the best-value 1 kWh station for outages and camping; $449–$499 is the October target.
cards.skip_if: a storm is in the forecast — buy now, don't wait; the popular sizes sell out in a day.
cards.owners: Owners praise the recharge speed and Anker's support. Complaint: loud fans on fast charge.
cards.video_title: 6 best portable power stations of 2026 — including the C1000 Gen 2

cards.name: EcoFlow DELTA 3 Plus
cards.price: Real deal at $599 or less · great at $549 (list $999)
cards.chip: Sub-10 ms UPS · 1,000 W solar · grows to 5 kWh
cards.buy_if: you want the fast-charging 1 kWh alternative that takes an expansion battery, and it's under $600.
cards.skip_if: it's $650-plus; the C1000 Gen 2 at $499 does the same job for less.
cards.owners: Owners praise the UPS and the app. Complaints: the account requirement, and it runs warm under heavy load.

cards.name: Jackery Explorer 2000 v2
cards.price: Real deal at $749 or less · buy without waiting at $649 (list $1,499; Black Friday low $599)
cards.buy_if: you need 2 kWh for the fridge, a CPAP and lights through a multi-day outage, and it's under $750.
cards.skip_if: it's $800-plus — Black Friday brought $599 last year, so wait seven weeks.
cards.owners: Owners love the simplicity and the weight. Complaint: fan noise on fast charge.

cards.name: Ray-Ban Meta (Gen 2)
cards.badge: Smart glasses · wait for Connect first
cards.price: Real deal at $299 or less (list $379; Meta Connect on Sept 23–24 comes first)
cards.buy_if: Meta announces the Gen 3 on Sept 23–24 and the Gen 2 drops to $299 — then October is your moment.
cards.skip_if: you're tempted by a brand-new Gen 3 or the Ray-Ban Display at full price; new Meta hardware isn't discounted for months.
cards.owners: Owners call them addictive fun. Complaints: privacy defaults, and features that arrive months late.

cards.name: Apple AirTag 2 (4-pack)
cards.price: Real deal at $79.99 or less for four (list $99)
cards.chip: Louder · finds from 50% farther · Apple Watch finding
cards.buy_if: you have an iPhone and keys, luggage or a bike to protect; $79.99 is the record low and the October target.
cards.skip_if: you're on Android — get the Chipolo Pop or Galaxy SmartTag2 instead (both about $29).
cards.owners: Owners call it 'much louder' and easier to find. Complaints: still no keyring hole, and the same coin battery.

cards.name: Owala FreeSip (24 oz)
cards.price: Real deal at $24 or less (list $29.99; sale floor $23.99)
cards.chip: Sip or chug · locks shut · cold for 24 h
cards.buy_if: you want the colour you like at $24 — it sells out before it gets cheaper.
cards.skip_if: it's a 'deal' at $27–$28; that's just the everyday price of the 32-ounce.
cards.owners: Reported 117,000+ ratings at 4.6 stars. Praise: the lid. Complaints: clean the gasket or it molds; lock it or it leaks.

cards.name: Bissell Little Green (1400B)
cards.price: Real deal at $89 or less (list $123.59; Black Friday low $81)
cards.buy_if: you have pets, kids or a light-coloured couch and it's under $90 in October.
cards.skip_if: it's $95-plus (that's its everyday price) or you want it for whole carpets — it's a spot cleaner.
cards.owners: Praise: the before-and-after on a 'clean' couch. Complaints: loud as a shop vac, a short 4-foot hose, tanks that need drying.
